answer: By the cipher of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The vault is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jetty. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
